tunnel.title: Cloudflare / ngrok setup
tunnel.intro: Create a secure tunnel from this phone to the OpenCode server on your computer. Run the setup commands on that computer.
tunnel.start: Install OpenCode and the selected tunnel tool. In terminal 1, replace choose-a-long-password with your own strong password and start the server. In terminal 2, start the tunnel. Keep both terminals running.
tunnel.warning: A public tunnel exposes your server to the internet. Keep OpenCode password authentication enabled. ngrok requires an account and its own login. Cloudflare browser/email authentication cannot be completed by this native client. Stop the tunnel when finished.
tunnel.paste: Paste the HTTPS address printed by the tunnel. Enter the same OpenCode password you set on the computer. The app tests the connection before saving it.
tunnel.failed: Could not connect. Check the tunnel address, server password and that both terminals are running.
tunnel.passwordRequired: Set a password on the server and enter it here before using a public tunnel.
tunnel.cloudflare: Cloudflare requires an account, a domain and a named tunnel. In the dashboard, create a Tunnel, then add a Published application route for your public hostname with Service URL http://127.0.0.1:{{port}}. Replace YOUR_TUNNEL_TOKEN in command 2 with the token provided by Cloudflare. Keep this token on the computer; the phone only needs the public hostname and the OpenCode password. Quick trycloudflare.com tunnels do not support the live event stream.

history.title: Offline session history
history.privacy: Optional encrypted copies of recently opened conversations, stored only on this device. Stores up to 20 sessions per connection and the last 40 text messages per session, within a size limit. Tool output, attachments and reasoning are excluded. Messages may contain sensitive text. Disable capture to stop future saves; clear history to remove existing copies.
history.clear: Clear all saved history and stop capture
history.confirm: Delete offline copies for all connections on this device? Server sessions remain available.
history.failed: Could not read or update offline history. Try again or clear saved history.
history.empty: No saved conversations yet. Enable saving, then open a session online. Switch connections to view another server’s saved history.
history.readOnly: Saved copy · read only · may be incomplete or out of date
